deniedCandidates.rationale: SetCircleBorder and every unlisted Image member stay outside the cross-platform deterministic Host boundary.
The inventory is deny-by-default; unlisted members reject.
No approved expected pair defines whitespace or Unicode trimming.
Frozen full state contains no radius serialization or command.
The selected slice does not execute this absent sandbox surface.
Unobserved scope/shared/close modes must not acquire guessed semantics.

compatibilityDecisions.rationale: One shared core emits one canonical result above mechanics-only adapters.
Normalize trace ACTIVE to the production lifecycle name OPEN.
Only observed Lua types and literals are accepted.
Add the mandatory runtime/token/transaction tuple without mutating oracle goldens.
Resolve providers, schemas, and controls by generic maps rather than identity behavior.
Historical forks and bug workarounds are not compatibility requirements.
